description: Public Electric Charging Station Locations in Georgia is a dataset listed in Fulton County open data portal (sharefulton.fultoncountyga.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Fulton County. This dataset contains the geographic coordinates for each public electric vehicle charging station in the state of Georgia according to data from the National Renewable Energy Laboratory (NREL). Stations with the same coordinates rounded to the nearest thousandth of a degree are considered to be the same location are represented by a single record. Coverage: Fulton County, Georgia. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are spmo. The table has 8 columns. The portal shows 2022-04-01 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-sharefulton-fultoncountyga-gov-portal.
